name: r11_thicker_bottom
why: The same shell as case 10, but what changes is the WALL THICKNESS: from 5 to 12. The bottom moves 7 mm downwards, and the box outside does not change by a millimetre. It is the case in which the bounding box does not help: from outside the part is identical.
intent_why: thickening the wall the bottom goes down from z = 47 to z = 40, and a hole «in the bottom» must follow it. The outer bounding box stays 314 x 274 x 52: here the volume is the only witness.

after.tolerance_why: THE VOLUME IS NOT ENOUGH, and it is the risk the entry named: the hole removes the same material whether it follows the bottom or stays where it was. Following it (z 40..43) the centroid is at 37.031; staying put (z 47..50) it is at 36.992. Thirty-eight thousandths, and the hundredth of tolerance tells them apart
